away.name: Yaroslav Askarov
away.news: The Sharks are off to a modest 4-3-1 start to the season, but Askarov's quality goaltending has been few and far between, leaving little room for error. Askarov has allowed three or more goals in every outing this season, including five on 25 shots (.800 SV%) in his most recent game, a 6-3 loss to the Boston Bruins. The 24-year-old goalie has an ugly 3.99 GAA and .848 SV% in five games (2-3-0). The Sharks enter Monday's contest as +114 road underdogs against a Toronto Maple Leafs team on a three-game losing streak (0-1-2).

home.name: Sergei Bobrovsky
home.news: The Maple Leafs hoped Bobrovsky's poor 2025-26 season with the Florida Panthers was an anomaly, but his start to the 2026-27 season hasn't been encouraging. The veteran 38-year-old goalie has an ugly 3.29 GAA and .891 SV%, winning only one of six games (1-3-2). He has allowed three or more goals in each game this season. The Maple Leafs enter Monday's contest as -127 home favourites against a 4-3-1 San Jose Sharks team.

away.name: Arturs Silovs
away.news: The Penguins are in a three-game losing streak (0-3-0) and hope to return to the win column on Monday, turning to Silovs to tend the twine against the Utah Mammoth. The 25-year-old Latvian goalie started the season with a 19-save shutout in a 7-0 win over the Philadelphia Flyers, but he has struggled since, allowing five goals in three of four games (2-2-0) and posting a 4.00 GAA and .853 SV%. The Penguins enter Friday's contest as +164 road underdogs against a 6-3-0 Mammoth team.

home.name: Sebastian Cossa
home.news: Over the weekend, Utah's Head Coach André Tourigny indicated he wanted a more even goalie rotation, and he is acting on it immediately by turning to Cossa to tend the twine on Monday. The 23-year-old Cossa was excellent in his season debut, saving 18 of 19 shots (.947 SV%) in a 4-1 win over the Columbus Blue Jackets, but has struggled in two outings since, allowing four goals on 12 shots (.667 SV%). The Mammoth enter Monday's action as -183 home favourites against a Pittsburgh Penguins team that has been outscored 16-7 during a three-game losing streak (0-3-0).
